title: Micro liaison bento - availability & handoff matrix
content:
Purpose:
Quick, transplantable mini-spreadsheet to surface who to ping for immediate cross-functional handoffs and short-run coverage. Built for weekend launches / tiny outages where we want zero-ambiguity contact + a lightweight capacity estimate (hours available / week).

How to use:
- Update 'Last check-in' after any calendar changes (sync weekly).
- If primary is not available, escalate to Backup. If both unavailable, follow FALLBACK column.
- Keep rows concise; this is an operational cheat-sheet, not a full RACI.

Columns (CSV-style):
Liaison,Primary owner,Backup owner,Slack handle,Avail windows (local),Coverage notes,Capacity (hrs/week),Oncall (Y/N),Priority tags,Last check-in,Fallback

Rows (current snapshot):
Platform Infra,Miguel Ortega,Sasha Patel,@miguel_o,PST 09:00-13:00 (best),Handles burst-capacity claims; prefers async handoffs,8-12,Y,burst-capacity,2026-04-19,Infra-Triage Pager (svc-team)
Product Ops,Lena Fischer,Anika Sharma,@lena_f,CET 14:00-18:00,Can run quick toggles and rollback feature flags,6-10,N,flagging,2026-04-18,product-ops-rotation
Serving Runtime,Omar Khan,Tom Chen,@omar_k,PST 22:00-02:00,Overlaps APAC; good for late-night fallbacks,10-15,Y,latency,2026-04-20,serving-runtime-standby
Observability,Priya Nair,Julia Park,@priya_n,CET 09:00-12:00,Can attach traces and run flamegraphs; prefers alert tickets,6,N,alerts/traces,2026-04-17,obs-oncall-swap
Solutions Eng,Marcus Lee,Sarah Vu,@marcus_l,PST 11:00-15:00,Customer outages / account escalations; can do playbook calls,5-8,N,customer-facing,2026-04-16,se-team-escalt
Hosting / Dedicated,Elena Rossi,Daniel Park,@elena_r,CET 16:00-20:00,Capacity for reserved pools, handles quotas,7-9,N,capacity,2026-04-15,hosting-burst
Customer Success,Julia Park,Marcus Lee,@julia_p,CET 08:00-12:00,Account contact and contract escalation,4-6,N,account,2026-04-19,cs-urgent-line
Sales Engineering,Tom Chen,Priya Nair,@tom_c,PST 08:00-11:00,Pre-sales deadlines and demo recovery support,3-6,N,demos,2026-04-14,sales-eng-fallback

Quick tallies (auto-run check):
- People with Oncall=Y: 2 (Miguel, Omar)
- Average capacity estimate (median): ~7 hrs/week
- Coverage gaps: late CET evenings (20:00-02:00 CET) scarce

Open questions / TODOs:
- Add explicit phone/ICD dial-in for high-severity (S1) events? (asked Legal; awaiting ok)
- Confirm alternate fallback for Platform Infra during long weekends (need 2x backup).
- Can Product Ops authorize quick toggle without a PR during emergency? (PR policy JIRA-876 pending)

Action items (owners):
- Anika: confirm weekend fallback roster and update this sheet (due 2026-04-24)
- Miguel: verify infra oncall overlap and add Pager ID to Fallback column (due 2026-04-21)
- Lena: create mini-runbook for 'feature rollback' and link into CONFLUENCE:runbook-coverage (due 2026-04-25)

Notes & informal chatter (keeps the doc usable in drive):
- 2026-04-19 quick test: pinged Miguel at 11:05 PST — he acknowledged within 7m (keeps confidence score high).
- If a row owner leaves, mark row with 'departing' and add interim owner; do not delete historical rows.
- This sheet is intentionally lightweight: if you need a full RACI + phonebook, open 'ops-larger-handbook' (Confluence).
